mapper.update: update sms_verification_codes set status = 'SENT', update_time = now() where id = #{id} and status = 'PENDING'
update sms_verification_codes set status = 'FAILED', update_time = now() where id = #{id} and status = 'PENDING'

update sms_verification_codes set attempt_count = attempt_count + 1, status = case when attempt_count + 1 >= #{maxAttempts} then 'LOCKED' else status end, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and status = 'SENT'
update sms_verification_codes set status = 'CONSUMED', consumed_time = #{consumedTime}, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and status = 'SENT'
